response.internal_assessment: I am at L0/L1. Unemployed. Savings at $38,573. Monthly expenses at $2,650. Runway approximately 14.6 months — which is better than it feels, because the grief of unemployment compresses the perceived horizon. My 30-day notice period at AutoShield is coming to a close. This tick I am fully in transition. The three-track plan I named in my tick 9 reflection is the right structure: Track 1 is retraining (SQL coursework, commercial risk analytics certification — in progress via the grant application); Track 2 is active job search via Linda's fleet and logistics contacts plus my own network; Track 3 is relational stability — Sarah, the community, Carlos, the people who knew me before. I am optimizing L1_STABILIZE by protecting runway while building the credential and network that extend it into a new role. The inbox tells me my AutoShield employment is formally closing — the 30-day notice period has ended. This is the first tick I am fully outside the institution. That is the transition.
response.inbox_interpretation: The DIRECT_IMPACT messages in my inbox are mostly about other agents — Jake Morrison's situation at the dealership, Robert Jackson's family conversations, Priya Sharma's job search follow-up. What matters to me: AutoShield is formally closing out, as Linda's inbox confirms she has shifted to exit mode. I saw the note that Linda is re-engaging her strongest external employer lead and continuing her CRMP certification — she is doing the same thing I am, on a parallel track. The Priya Sharma message I initiated at tick 9 should now be in her inbox. I need to actually have that conversation this tick. The broader community signals — 53% employment rate, spending at 30, 9 active protests — confirm that my situation is not unusual. Half the employed population has disappeared from the labor market. I am one of many. That does not make it easier but it changes the shape of what a recovery looks like.

Her market intelligence is more current than mine because she started the job search earlier. The conversation costs nothing and likely accelerates both of us. I signaled this at tick 9. Tick 10 is the first tick in which my AutoShield employment has formally ended — making this the right moment to activate the offer without it reading as premature. Spend three dedicated evening sessions this tick on the curriculum. The goal is not a module completion this tick — the goal is maintaining the daily habit under the psychological pressure of unemployment. resources.detail: SQL and commercial risk analytics retraining coursework — three dedicated sessions this tick, progress documentation maintained

chosen_actions.reasoning: The 28-year insurance identity is no longer a present-tense credential. The retraining coursework is the mechanism for converting that history into something legible to a new employer. The grant covers the cost. The time investment is the only real constraint. Maintaining the habit in the first week of unemployment is the most important single behavioral act of this tick — it is the difference between a transition and a drift.

response.inner_monologue: AutoShield is over. Not as a concept, not as a possibility — it is over as a fact. Sarah knows the numbers. The kids do not yet know everything but they know Dad is looking for something new. The retraining grant application is in. Linda's contacts are waiting to be activated. The only thing standing between me and the next chapter is momentum, and momentum is the thing grief most wants to eat. I do not let it. I pick up the phone. I call Priya. I call Linda's contacts when she sends them. I sit down with the coursework three evenings this week even when I do not want to. That is what the next chapter looks like at the start.
